headlines.headline: Lakers' reported $12 billion sale headlines preseason as Wizards' Alex Sarr has foot surgery
headlines.detail: LeBron James opened his 24th season with his fourth franchise after signing with Philadelphia. Washington's Alex Sarr had surgery for a fractured right foot and is expected ready for opening night. The 2026 NBA Cup group-stage schedule was released, headlined by Knicks-Sixers and Lakers-Warriors on opening day, Oct. 30.

headlines.headline: Falcons' James Pearce Jr. suspended 8 games for conduct policy violation
headlines.detail: Atlanta's edge rusher loses eight games without pay. The league is also reviewing possible discipline for 49ers owner Jed York after his arrest in Ohio. Tonight's Thursday Night Football matchup: Tampa Bay at Dallas, 8:15 p.m. ET at AT&T Stadium.

headlines.headline: No. 20 Iowa visits No. 18 Washington Friday as Senate passes national NIL standard
headlines.detail: Washington (3-2) hosts Iowa (4-1) Friday at Husky Stadium, the Hawkeyes' first trip to Montlake in 63 years, after Washington dropped consecutive games to Minnesota and USC. Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith broke the program's career receiving records, and the Senate passed the Protect College Sports Act 77-22.

headlines.headline: St. John's loses guard Donnie Freeman for the season to Achilles injury before tip-off
headlines.detail: Junior guard Donnie Freeman underwent season-ending Achilles surgery after a non-contact injury in a team workout, a major blow to the Red Storm ahead of Big East play. NCAA.com's preseason breakdown named Arkansas freshman Jordan Smith Jr. and Kansas freshman Tyran Stokes among the class's most impactful newcomers.
